_doc: Maps of other pret decomps that the converters read as if they were pokeruby's (events agent, 2026-10-07): Emerald's event islands (user decision 2026-10-07: pokeemerald and pokefirered cloned in external/, source only). converter/gba.py: Repo(pokeruby).map_json(name) falls back to the decomp named here, its layout is registered under its own id and its tilesets are namespaced '<tag>:gTileset_X' (Emerald's General/Dewford/Rustboro/Fortree differ from Ruby's at some metatiles, checked pixel by pixel), map_folders() knows their MAP_ ids. Labels for the namespaced tilesets: data/labels/emerald_islands.json (plan_map.py; a metatile that renders and behaves exactly as Ruby's same tileset id takes Ruby's label). Metatile behaviour numbers are the same in both decomps (checked: only names differ). Not listed (not built): BirthIsland_Harbor and NavelRock_Harbor, the S.S. Tidal's landing rooms: the ferry docks at the islands' docks as at Southern Island, and the exteriors' doors to them stay parked. To add another event map: list it here, then follow notes/EVENTS.md.
